faq.q: Can the photos or videos show what my supplement does?
faq.a: Show how and when the product is used, not a health result. Keep claims and dosage wording in text your team approves, and skip scenes that imply a body change.

faq.q: Why does the label look washed out in my result?
faq.a: Glare on a glossy label usually starts in the source photo. Shoot the bottle upright with the front label centered and use soft side light instead of direct light.

faq.q: Can I use these photos in paid wellness ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads are watermark-free and licensed for commercial use, including paid ads and product pages. Any health claim or offer text you add must be accurate.

faq.q: Do I need to hire a model or a creator?
faq.a: No. Generated people and hands are placed around your product for a per-image credit cost. Arrange a real creator separately if you want a true customer story.

faq.q: Can I use an image as an Instagram Story?
faq.a: Photos come out square. For a vertical Story, make a 9:16 clip and post that instead.

faq.q: What format are the photos and clips delivered in?
faq.a: Photos are square JPGs. Clips are vertical 9:16 at 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, so one product works across feeds and listings.
